papers.title: Vision-Language Agents Can Learn in Their Own Latent Worlds
papers.abstract: Learning from experience is essential for building the next generation of agents that continually expand their capabilities. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) already internalize rich world knowledge, yet this knowledge is rarely leveraged to drive policy improvement through online interaction. Realizing this potential efficiently remains challenging, as policy updates shift the agent's interaction distribution, requiring the world model to adapt accordingly, while continually updating large pretrained models is computationally expensive. To address this challenge, we introduce Dwell, a model-based reinforcement learning (RL) framework that reframes a VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator, endowing it with the ability to predict, adjust, and act in latent space. Leveraging the VLM's own representations and its dual role as both world model and policy, the agent continually learns from real interactions to anticipate and evaluate action outcomes, and from latent imagination to improve its behavior. Across five interactive visual environments, Dwell achieves the strongest overall performance among trainable methods while substantially reducing the compute required for imagination, showing that effective world models for VLM agents need not reconstruct the future; they need to predict futures that are useful for action. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tom111-lhx/Dwell

summary.takeaway: 提出 Dwell，将 VLM 视为循环潜在转移算子，统一世界模型与策略，使智能体能在其潜在空间中进行想象与策略改进。
summary.methods: 基于模型的强化学习框架：用 VLM 自身的表征同时作为世界模型和策略，从真实交互学习预测并评估动作结果，并从潜在想象中改进行为；在五个交互式视觉环境中评估，并比较想象计算开销。
summary.relevance: 涉及强化学习、预训练 VLM 与多模态学习，直接关联如何利用预训练模型的内部知识驱动在线策略学习。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告在五个交互式视觉环境中的整体表现与计算缩减，未给出具体数值或跨域泛化细节。

papers.title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formulate a textbook-based mathematical problem-solving task. LLMs must navigate textbook exposition, learn and apply relevant principles, and construct proofs for exercises, with reference solutions withheld. We introduce a BookNavigator interface to support this human-inspired study process and incentivize self-learning through reinforcement learning (RL) with fine-grained rewards. Experiments show that our method improves performance across in-domain and out-of-domain textbooks and subjects, raising Intern-S2-Preview-35B's overall proof accuracy from 51.5% to 79.5% and outperforming RL-trained textbook-free and fixed-retrieval baselines. These gains extend to complex long-context benchmarks involving different task types, with improvements over the base model of 1.7 and 2.3 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus and CL-bench, respectively. Together, these findings suggest that RL can foster a domain-agnostic self-learning strategy, highlighting the potential of self-learning from long-form corpora to strengthen broader problem-solving capabilities on complex, long-context tasks.

summary.takeaway: 通过强化学习激励 LLM 自主检索、学习并应用长文本教材知识，形成领域无关的自学习策略。
summary.methods: 构建基于教材的数学解题任务，参考解答被隐藏；引入 BookNavigator 接口支持检索与学习过程，并用细粒度奖励的 RL 训练；在域内、域外教材及长上下文基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型、检索增强与对齐及强化学习，关注超越固定 RAG 的自主知识获取与推理耦合。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明奖励设计细节、训练成本及在非数学领域任务中的泛化边界；性能提升为特定模型与基准上的报告结果。

papers.title: Prediction transfer does not imply reliability transfer in single-cell foundation models
papers.abstract: Single-cell foundation models are increasingly transferred across tissues, diseases, perturbation screens, and experimental platforms. Although substantial effort has focused on prediction transfer, it remains unclear whether a model's assessment of its own reliability transfers similarly across biological contexts. Here we define reliability transfer as the ability to transfer an accurate assessment of when model predictions are likely to be correct or incorrect and investigate its behavior across ten perturbation-prediction systems spanning multiple datasets, models, and evaluation settings. We find that reliability transfer varies substantially across source-target pairs and cannot be inferred from predictive performance alone, indicating that prediction transfer and reliability transfer constitute distinct forms of generalization. Analyses of biological annotations, network connectivity, target exposure, and contextual factors reveal that prediction reliability is associated with both shared and context-dependent signals, with their relative importance differing across systems. To characterize this variability, we introduce reliability-attribution fingerprints, context-level signatures derived from strictly cross-fitted SHAP explanations that summarize how reliability estimators combine biological and contextual information when assigning confidence. Across systems, contexts with similar attribution-magnitude fingerprints tended to transfer reliability more successfully, and fingerprint similarity identified transfer sources achieving higher reliability-transfer performance within the observed candidate set. However, these relationships weakened under stricter cross-family transfer settings, indicating that transferable reliability structure remains partly dependent on shared contextual information. Finally, transferred reliability estimators produced different perturbation rankings despite identical perturbation predictions, illustrating a practical consequence of reliability transfer for downstream prioritization. Together, these results establish reliability transfer as a distinct aspect of foundation-model generalization and introduce reliability-attribution fingerprints as a framework for characterizing transferable reliability structure across biological contexts.

summary.takeaway: 单细胞基础模型的预测迁移不等于可靠性迁移；可靠性迁移是独立于预测性能的泛化维度。
summary.methods: 在 10 个扰动预测系统中考察可靠性迁移，分析生物注释、网络连接、目标暴露与上下文因素；提出基于严格交叉拟合 SHAP 的可靠性归因指纹，用于刻画可靠性估计器如何组合生物与上下文信息。
summary.relevance: 直接关联单细胞扰动、Cell Foundation Model 与预训练模型的跨上下文迁移评估。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出在更严格的跨家族迁移设置下指纹与迁移性能的关系减弱，说明可迁移可靠性结构仍部分依赖共享上下文；参考结果为关联性分析而非因果结论。

papers.title: MLLM-GS: Multimodal Large Language Model Prior-Guided Fast Novel View Synthesis in Extreme Environments
papers.abstract: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS

summary.takeaway: 提出 MLLM-GS，利用冻结 MLLM 的视觉先验增强退化场景视图，并结合高效 3DGS 实现快速新视角合成。
summary.methods: 双分支框架：MLLM 先验引导的视图增强分支，用少量配对清晰视图监督轻量校正网络以减少像素偏移和颜色偏差；快速 3D 重建分支优化光栅化、高斯内存布局和参数更新。
summary.relevance: 涉及多模态大语言模型先验与多模态学习，面向极端环境下视觉重建与生成。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体重建时间、内存节省幅度及退化类型覆盖范围；增强视图作为伪 GT 的误差传播风险未被量化。

papers.title: Textual Response-Aware Guidance for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing adversarial fine-tuning methods often use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image--text alignment while improving robustness. Our analysis of visual representation drift reveals complementary limitations of two representative forms of guidance. Matching visual features provides broad coverage by constraining all directions equally, but lacks semantic emphasis. Matching prediction distributions prioritizes semantically relevant directions, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities. These limitations can hinder preservation of pre-trained image--text relationships and degrade zero-shot performance. To address these issues, we propose Textual Response-Aware Guidance (TRAG), which constrains visual representation drift using the pre-trained text encoder's responses to local variations in input embeddings. Specifically, TRAG constructs anchor-level constraints from the response directions and magnitudes around semantic anchors, then aggregates them using pre-trained image--anchor relevance, yielding an image-adaptive constraint. Extensive experiments across architectures and tasks demonstrate state-of-the-art clean and robust performance. Further analysis shows that TRAG helps preserve pre-trained image--text relationships.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TRAG，利用预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部变化的响应构造锚级约束，以保持 VLM 零样本对抗鲁棒性微调中的图文关系。
summary.methods: 分析视觉表征漂移，指出匹配视觉特征与匹配预测分布两种引导的互补局限；TRAG 从语义锚周围的响应方向和幅度构建约束，并按预训练图像-锚相关性聚合为图像自适应约束；跨架构和任务实验。
summary.relevance: 关联视觉-语言模型、多模态学习与对齐，关注对抗微调中预训练跨模态关系的保持。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称达到最优干净与鲁棒性能，未列出具体攻击类型、威胁模型及计算开销数据。

papers.title: M-PFT: Angular Margin for Calibrated Prompt-Tuning of Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Prompt-tuning has emerged as a parameter-efficient technique for adapting large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks while keeping the pre-trained weights frozen. However, prompt-tuned VLMs often suffer from a base-to-novel dual miscalibration problem, where models typically show underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes. Current VLM calibration approaches address this dual miscalibration either separately or jointly, but lack a geometric understanding of the hyperspherical embedding space and thus fail to exploit angular discriminative properties to adjust distorted decision boundaries. To address this, we propose M-PFT, a novel angular-margin approach for prompt tuning that introduces two complementary objectives to promote class discriminability and semantic anchoring. This enlarges the angular margin by 1) minimizing the maximum cosine similarity between tunable class embeddings to reduce embedding collapse and 2) minimizing the angular distance between each tunable embedding and its corresponding zero-shot embedding to preserve semantic geometry. Extensive experiments across 9 prompt-tuning methods with various backbones on 15 diverse datasets show that our approach reduces the average calibration error on novel classes, while remaining competitive on base classes and maintaining comparable accuracy. Further analyses reveal that M-PFT effectively adjusts distorted decision boundaries induced by prompt tuning while preserving the pre-trained embedding space, improving calibration with negligible computational overhead.
authors: Udaya Sampath K. Perera Miriya Thanthrige

summary.takeaway: 提出 M-PFT，通过角度边际目标缓解提示微调 VLM 的基类-新类双重校准问题。
summary.methods: 在提示微调中引入两个互补目标：最小化可训练类嵌入间最大余弦相似度以减少嵌入坍缩，并最小化可训练嵌入与其零样本嵌入间角度距离以保持语义几何；在 9 种提示微调方法、多种骨干和 15 个数据集上评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及 VLM 提示微调、多模态对齐与跨模态理解，关注参数高效适配后的校准与决策边界几何。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告新类平均校准误差降低且基类具竞争力，但未给出具体误差数值或精度变化幅度。

papers.title: TCC-RAG: Temporal Causal Chain-Guided RAG for Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have spurred growing interest in temporal knowledge graph question answering (TKGQA). Most existing methods rely on semantic retrieval augmented generation (RAG), which suffers from fundamental limitations in complex temporal reasoning. On the one hand, semantic-based RAG methods struggle to capture the multi-hop causal knowledge required for complex temporal reasoning. On the other hand, these methods introduce excessive redundant knowledge, trapping LLMs in spurious reasoning chains that potentially result in erroneous answers. To address these problems, we propose a Temporal Causal Chain-guided RAG (TCC-RAG) to retrieve a concise yet sufficient set of causal knowledge to support complex temporal reasoning. Specifically, we reformulate the temporal knowledge graph into a multi-view causal cue graph, with causal cues inducing connections that explicitly encode temporal evolution and causal dynamics. Based on the causal cue graph, we construct a query-specific temporal causal chain to guide the retrieval process, enabling the model to focus on a concise set of causally relevant knowledge. Finally, we introduce a causal evidence filter to refine the retrieved knowledge, ensuring its causal consistency with the underlying temporal logic of the query. Experiments show that TCC-RAG achieves substantial performance gains of 10.72% and 8.40% on two TKGQA benchmarks, and delivers a remarkable 62.97% improvement for multi-step temporal reasoning.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TCC-RAG，利用时间因果链引导检索，为时序知识图谱问答提供简洁且因果充分的证据。
summary.methods: 将时序知识图谱重构为多视图因果线索图，编码时间演化与因果动态；构建查询特定的时间因果链指导检索；引入因果证据过滤器保证与查询时序逻辑的因果一致性；在两个 TKGQA 基准上实验。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型、检索增强与知识图谱，针对复杂时序推理中的多跳因果检索与冗余知识问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告两个基准上的提升及多步时序推理改进，但未说明基准规模、基线范围及因果链构建失败情形。

papers.title: inkGround: Benchmarking Fine-grained Visual Grounding Capabilities of Vision-Language Models for Cursive Handwriting in the Wild
papers.abstract: Human handwriting is produced as an ordered sequence of pen movements, but an offline image keeps only the final ink. Handwriting trajectory recovery aims to restore the ordered stroke points and their pen-up/pen-down transitions. Existing image-trajectory pair datasets are recorded with digitizing tablets under controlled conditions, which limits writer coverage and stylistic diversity. Moreover, there is no benchmark that measures the visual grounding capabilities of general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for the stroke trajectory recovery task. In this work, we introduce inkGround, a benchmark for stroke trajectory recovery from full-page, camera-captured handwriting. inkGround pairs 537 page images (~18.7k words, ~163k strokes) with reference trajectories produced by a pretrained offline-to-online model, filtered by OCR agreement, and verified by human raters. Because these references are pseudo-labels that represent one plausible pen trajectory, we also evaluate VLMs on the IAM-OnDB dataset, which provides recorded pen trajectories. We cast the task as text-conditioned point grounding: given a page image and a target word, the model must locate the word and output its ordered stroke points. Outputs are scored by trajectory fidelity (DTW, Chamfer distance), readability of the rendered strokes (Accurate Rate, Correct Rate), and style similarity. We benchmark four open-source and three frontier closed-source VLMs with a shared in-context prompt. Closed-source models, notably Gemini-3.1-Pro, produce legible trajectories close to the reference, and this ranking also holds on IAM-OnDB.

summary.takeaway: 提出 inkGround，用于评测 VLM 在真实拍摄整页连笔手写上的细粒度视觉定位与笔迹轨迹恢复能力。
summary.methods: 将任务形式化为文本条件点定位：给定页面图像与目标词，输出有序笔画点；数据集含 537 页图像（约 18.7k 词、约 163k 笔画）与预训练离线到在线模型生成的伪轨迹参考，经 OCR 一致性与人工核验；另在提供记录轨迹的 IAM-OnDB 上评估；用 DTW、Chamfer 距离、可读性准确率/正确率及风格相似度打分；评测四个开源与三个闭源前沿 VLM。
summary.relevance: 涉及多模态学习与跨模态理解，关注通用 VLM 对手写笔迹的细粒度视觉定位。
summary.caveat: 主数据集参考轨迹为伪标签，仅代表一种合理笔迹路径；摘要未给出各模型的详细分数分布及伪标签噪声的定量影响。

papers.title: Automatic Iconographic Annotation of Medieval Illuminations: Comparing Generative Vision-Language Models and Supervised Discriminative Classifiers
papers.abstract: The large-scale digitisation of medieval manuscripts creates a growing need for automated iconographic indexing. We evaluate two complementary paradigms for this task on 9,735 full-folio images annotated with 2,333 TIMEL concepts: generative Vision-Language Models (VLM) and supervised discriminative classifiers (SDC). The VLM experiments evaluate fine-tuning, structured JSON decoding, taxonomybased candidates generation, and deterministic reranking. The discriminative experiments evaluate flat, hierarchy-aware, and patch-attention heads over a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Our results highlight key functional differences: ML-Decoder (SDC) achieves the strongest overall retrieval performance (precision@1 of 0.696, MRR of 0.806), with loss calibration (Asymmetric Loss) serving as the primary performance lever. While SDCs provide superior precision and reliability within a closed vocabulary, VLMs offer strong semantic generalization and broad taxonomic coverage, particularly through structured JSON targets and verify-calibrate reranking (hierarchical F1 of 0.559). Furthermore, model behavior strongly depends on concept abstraction: SDCs excel at perceptually grounded descriptive concepts, whereas VLMs provide useful hypotheses for complex interpretative scenes. Finally, we find that enforcing explicit hierarchy within model architectures limits coverage compared to spatial feature aggregation. Overall, rather than competing approaches, SDCs and VLMs emerge as complementary components for future hybrid indexing systems combining structured retrieval with exploratory annotation assistance. As a methodological contribution, we define the soft F1 metric to provide a taxonomy-aware evaluation that credits semantically close predictions based on lowest common ancestors.

summary.takeaway: 在中世纪手抄本插图标注任务上，系统对比生成式视觉语言模型（VLM）与监督判别式分类器（SDC）两种范式，发现二者功能互补：SDC在封闭词表内更精确，VLM在语义泛化与分类覆盖上更强。
summary.methods: 在9,735张整页图像、覆盖2,333个TIMEL概念的数据上评测。VLM侧考察微调、结构化JSON解码、基于分类体系的候选生成与确定性重排；SDC侧基于冻结的DINOv3编码器比较flat、层次感知与patch-attention头，并以非对称损失（Asymmetric Loss）调校。另定义soft F1指标，基于最低公共祖先对语义相近预测给予部分 credit。
summary.relevance: 与"多模态学习"和"跨模态理解与生成"直接相关：它比较了生成式多模态模型与判别式视觉模型在细粒度图像标注上的取舍，并涉及结构化输出与重排对齐策略。
summary.caveat: 结论限于中世纪手抄本插图这一专门领域和TIMEL封闭概念体系；摘要未报告跨数据集泛化或标注者间一致性；层次结构约束与空间特征聚合的比较仅基于该设定。

papers.title: GARDEN: Generalist Autonomous Reward Design Through Evidence Navigation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables teams of agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles, to learn coordinated behavior, but what such teams learn is largely determined by their reward function. Because task success alone provides too little guidance for learning, intermediate rewards are usually designed by hand, and this effort must often be repeated whenever the environment or the team changes. Large language models (LLMs) can automate the effort by writing reward functions as code, yet the resulting rewards are typically designed and tested in a single setting. To enable their reuse across settings, GARDEN (Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation) is proposed, in which one reward program is developed for a family of related scenarios and transferred, unchanged, to scenarios that were not available during its design. During development, environment code, training records, and agent behavior are investigated by an LLM reward engineer, and draft rewards are tested in trial training runs, while the learning algorithm and the rule for selecting the final reward are held fixed. On unseen scenarios of the Overcooked and SMAX benchmarks, task returns were increased by 58.2% and 52.5% over the default rewards on two kitchen layouts, and the mean win rate in two combat scenarios was raised from 51.0% to 89.9%. Under matched candidate and probe budgets, this exceeded the 84.2% and 79.2% obtained with fixed diagnostic feedback and Eureka-inspired reward reflection. These results show that a single autonomously engineered reward can be reused effectively across related cooperative scenarios.

summary.takeaway: 提出GARDEN，由LLM奖励工程师在环境代码、训练记录与智能体行为中取证并迭代设计一个奖励程序，使其无需修改即可迁移到设计时未见过的相关场景。
summary.methods: LLM在开发过程中检查环境代码、训练记录和智能体行为，草拟奖励并经试训验证；学习算法与最终奖励选择规则保持固定。在Overcooked与SMAX的未见场景上评测，并与固定诊断反馈和Eureka式奖励反思在相同候选与探测预算下比较。
summary.relevance: 与"大语言模型"、"强化学习"和"多智能体与奖励学习"相关：它用LLM自动化多智能体强化学习中的中间奖励设计，并关注奖励在不同环境间的复用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出两个基准上的部分场景结果，未说明场景族规模与多样性；奖励程序的可迁移性是否覆盖差异更大的环境未知；LLM生成的奖励程序本身的可解释性与安全性未讨论。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Global Climate Policy Cooperation
papers.abstract: International climate policy requires coordination among countries whose mitigation decisions impose local costs but generate global benefits. Classical game-theoretic and integrated assessment approaches can study these incentives, but typically rely on prescribed behavioural assumptions or equilibrium concepts. Recent work has therefore explored Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning as a way to model climate-policy cooperation as an emergent outcome of repeated strategic interaction. We extend an existing MARL climate framework with a multi-stage negotiation mechanism in which agents propose agreements, accept or reject commitments, and face penalties for non-compliance. This allows us to study how agreement design affects learned mitigation behaviour, compliance, and climate outcomes. In an idealized setting with four homogeneous agents, we find that non-binding agreements do little to overcome free-riding, while moderate non-compliance penalties improve cooperation and reduce warming. However, excessively strong penalties discourage ambitious commitments, revealing a trade-off between enforcement and participation. We position the framework as a methodological contribution for testing agreement design rather than a predictive model of real negotiations.

summary.takeaway: 在现有MARL气候框架中加入多阶段谈判机制（提议、接受或拒绝承诺、违约罚金），研究协议设计如何影响学到的减排行为、履约与气候结果。
summary.methods: 构建四同质智能体的理想化设定，在重复策略交互中让智能体学习减排与合作承诺，并比较无约束协议与不同强度的不合规罚金。
summary.relevance: 与"强化学习"和"多智能体与奖励学习"相关：以MARL作为研究气候政策合作涌现的建模工具，涉及奖励结构与履约激励设计。
summary.caveat: 作者明确将其定位为测试协议设计的方法学框架而非真实谈判的预测模型；结论基于四个同质智能体的理想化设定，异质国家、现实政治约束下的可推广性未验证。

papers.title: How Many and How Much? Contrastive Learning with Negative Samples for Knowledge Graph Embedding
papers.abstract: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE), a fundamental technique for knowledge-centric Web and KG-augmented AI applications, is commonly trained through contrastive learning with negative samples to learn discriminative representations. Despite its empirical success, two crucial questions regarding negative samples remain underexplored: (Q1) how many negative samples should be used for each positive sample and (Q2) how much should each negative sample contribute to learning? To answer these questions, we propose RADAR, a novel contrastive learning framework for KGE models with two effective strategies, respectively: (1) Risk-aware negative budget allocation quantifies false-negative sampling risk by modeling an open-world KG as a stochastic partial observation of its closed-world counterpart and adaptively assigns a negative budget to each positive sample based on its risk; (2) Distribution-calibrated negative weighting assigns negative weights by calibrating the weighting strength for each positive based on two complementary characteristics of the negative-score distribution: dispersion and concentration. Extensive experiments on 3 real-world KGs with 4 KGE models reveal that RADAR achieves the best KGE performance on average across all model--KG combinations and reduces sampled false negatives by over 90% compared with conventional fixed-budget methods.

summary.takeaway: 针对知识图谱嵌入中负样本"用多少"和"各贡献多少"两个问题，提出RADAR框架，分别用风险感知的负样本预算分配和分布校准的负样本加权来改进对比学习。
summary.methods: 把开放世界知识图谱建模为封闭世界真值的随机部分观测，以此量化假负样本风险并按风险为每个正样本自适应分配负样本预算；再依据负样本得分分布的离散度与集中度校准加权强度。在3个真实知识图谱、4种KGE模型上做实验。
summary.relevance: 与"知识图谱"、"自监督与表示学习"和"检索增强与对齐"相关：它改进知识图谱嵌入的对比训练，而嵌入质量直接影响以KG为支撑的检索与对齐。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告相对固定预算方法减少超过90%的采样假负样本并在平均上最优，但未给出各模型-图谱组合的具体增益分布；风险建模依赖开放世界为封闭世界随机观测的假设，该假设的合理性未在摘要中检验。

papers.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
papers.abstract: Foundation models are typically trained in stages: pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), with changes in both data and learning algorithms. We show that this algorithmic separation is not fundamental. By deriving suitable RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to model-generated target distributions, we place all of these stages under a single likelihood-based training algorithm, unified training. This perspective turns the foundation-model training lifecycle into a problem of choosing which data to train on, in what proportions, and when, with conventional staged training as a special case. We instantiate this framework in a unified training system that mixes static data and RL generations within a single trainer. Across controlled and real-world experiments, unified training improves the accuracy-compute tradeoff and task coverage while preserving broader capabilities, and provides a stronger starting point for continual learning. This work lays the groundwork for a unified science of foundation-model training, connecting mathematical principles, training infrastructure, and the development of model capabilities.

summary.takeaway: 提出"统一训练"视角：把预训练、midtraining、SFT与RL都表述为对模型生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，从而用同一个基于似然的算法完成各阶段训练。
summary.methods: 推导相应的RL目标使其等价于对模型生成目标分布的极大似然拟合，并在单一训练器中混合静态数据与RL生成数据来实现；在受控与真实实验上比较精度-算力权衡、任务覆盖与持续学习起点。
summary.relevance: 与"强化学习"、"持续学习"和"预训练"直接相关：它试图消解预训练与RL后训练之间的算法割裂，把训练生命周期转化为数据选择与配比问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体基准、模型规模或数值结果，难以判断改进幅度；将各阶段统一为似然拟合的理论等价性是否覆盖现有RL后训练实践中的全部设计（如奖励塑形、采样策略）未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
papers.abstract: While frontier vision-language models demonstrate strong capabilities in user interface (UI) navigation, their high inference costs prohibit everyday use. Conversely, smaller models trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or offline reinforcement learning often memorize static trajectories, leading to brittle execution and an inability to recover from errors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel online reinforcement learning framework that trains UI navigation agents directly on live iOS applications. Our framework decouples the agent into two specialized components: a Planning agent and a UI Grounding model. We rely on an LLM-as-a-Judge to provide comprehensive reward signals, combining dense, step-level feedback to evaluate intermediate progress with a terminal reward for overall task completion. To effectively leverage this dual reward structure, we optimize the agent using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with step-level advantage estimation. Furthermore, we introduce GiGPPO, a novel neighbor-conditioned value estimation method that improves critic stability by leveraging reward signals from visually similar states across concurrent trajectories. To support this online training paradigm at scale, we introduce an efficient infrastructure that orchestrates hundreds of concurrent virtual iOS devices. Evaluations on rigorous benchmarks, including UINavBench, iOSWorld, and AndroidWorld, demonstrate that our online RL trained agents substantially outperform both SFT and terminal-only RL baselines while accelerating training convergence. Notably, our 8B RL agents achieve nearly a sevenfold improvement over the SFT baseline in out-of-distribution generalization to Android environments, while outperforming Gemini-3.5-Flash and tying with Gemini-3.1-Pro on real iOS applications.

summary.takeaway: 提出在真实iOS应用上在线训练UI导航智能体的强化学习框架，将智能体解耦为规划智能体与UI grounding模型，并用LLM-as-a-Judge提供稠密步级奖励加终局奖励。
summary.methods: 用PPO结合步级优势估计优化；引入GiGPPO，利用并发轨迹中视觉相似状态的奖励信号做邻居条件化的价值估计以稳定critic；配套支持数百台并发虚拟iOS设备的基础设施。在UINavBench、iOSWorld、AndroidWorld上评测。
summary.relevance: 与"强化学习"、"多模态学习"和"跨模态理解与生成"相关：它把视觉语言模型用于UI理解与规划，并研究在线RL相对SFT与仅终局奖励RL的泛化优势。
summary.caveat: 摘要称8B RL智能体在跨域到Android时相对SFT基线有近七倍提升并与Gemini模型对比，但未说明评测样本量与统计显著性；在线训练依赖大规模虚拟设备基础设施，其成本与可复现性未在摘要中量化；LLM-as-a-Judge奖励的可靠性未评估。

papers.title: Post-Training Large Language Models with LLMON
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) treat all context tokens uniformly, lacking explicit separation between executable instructions and passive data. This leads to prompt injection vulnerabilities, ambiguous instruction binding, and unreliable execution control. We present a post-training methodology using LLMON (LLM Object Notation), a framework that enables separating instructions from data and requires explicit identifier-based execution. We construct a large-scale structured training corpus of 4.6B tokens spanning general, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and tool-calling data, augmented with distractor-infused variants in which competing instructions and irrelevant data segments are present in context but not referenced. Post-training two Granite-4.1 base models (3B and 8B) through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning, we show that LLMON-structured supervision reduces attack success rates on indirect prompt-injection benchmarks from 53-100% to 0.02-5.6% while preserving general capabilities. We further introduce attention-based interpretability metrics that diagnose failure modes at individual transformer layers for structured inputs, revealing how our approach reshapes internal attention patterns. Our results demonstrate that explicit execution semantics can be taught through standard post-training without architectural modification.

summary.takeaway: 提出LLMON后训练方法，通过显式区分指令与数据并要求基于标识符的显式执行，降低间接提示注入攻击成功率，同时保持通用能力。
summary.methods: 构建4.6B token的结构化训练语料，覆盖通用、RAG与工具调用数据，并加入含竞争指令与无关数据的干扰变体；对Granite-4.1 3B和8B基座模型做SFT后接RL后训练；另引入基于注意力的可解释性指标定位逐层失败模式。
summary.relevance: 与"大语言模型"、"检索增强与对齐"和"强化学习"相关：它针对RAG与工具调用场景下的指令-数据混淆问题，用标准后训练而非架构改动来教授显式执行语义。
summary.caveat: 攻击成功率下降的评估限于间接提示注入基准，未覆盖其他攻击类型；摘要未报告通用能力保持的具体幅度；结构化语料构造与干扰变体的设计细节及3B/8B以外的规模表现未说明。

papers.title: Evaluating Cultural Knowledge Editing in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently fail to recognize culture-specific concepts, especially from underrepresented regions. Effectively injecting this long-tail knowledge into existing models remains a challenge. In this work, we investigate knowledge editing as a targeted alternative by introducing CulturalBind, a benchmark comprising 3.2K images of 1K concepts from 6 domains, designed to evaluate culture-aware cross-modal knowledge as well as concept-level knowledge editing in VLMs. Pre-edit evaluation reveals that textual and visual knowledge is decoupled: models often demonstrate text-based knowledge of cultural concepts but fail to identify them from images. We then evaluate editing methods in single and sequential scenarios. Although current methods successfully correct individual visual recognition errors, they exhibit low cross-modal portability, failing to integrate edits into the model's broader parametric knowledge. Furthermore, performance degrades rapidly under sequential editing, highlighting the need for comprehensive adaptation approaches that better consolidate multimodal knowledge over time.

summary.takeaway: 提出CulturalBind基准（3.2K图像、1K概念、6个领域），评估视觉语言模型的文化知识编辑，发现文本知识与视觉识别相互脱节，现有编辑方法跨模态迁移性弱且序列编辑下迅速退化。
summary.methods: 构建面向文化特定概念的文化感知跨模态知识基准，在编辑前评测模型对文化概念的文本与视觉知识，然后在单次与序列编辑场景下评估现有知识编辑方法。
summary.relevance: 与"多模态学习"和"跨模态理解与生成"相关：它检验向多模态模型注入长尾文化知识的效果，揭示跨模态知识整合的瓶颈。
summary.caveat: 作为基准与评估论文，摘要未提出新的编辑方法；结论基于该基准的1K概念与6个领域，覆盖范围有限；文本-视觉知识解耦的判断依赖所测模型集合，未说明模型数量与选择依据。

papers.title: Telling Is Not Seeing: Textual Personas Rarely Make Vision-Language Models Answer Like the People They Describe
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly prompted with personas, such as "You have low vision", to stand in for people in user studies. We ask whether a persona makes a model see like the person it describes. We compare persona answers with measured people with low vision, color blindness or hearing loss, and with simple rules that use only the facts the persona states. The persona never beats these rules, and it erases the real differences between groups and individuals. Describing blur leaves recognition unchanged in all 14 models we test, while blurring the photo lowers it as it does for people. Inside open models, the description changes neither the image information nor the answer probabilities. Yet the models know the effects they fail to show: they can estimate how blur and illusions affect people. Telling is not seeing: a persona makes a model say what it knows about people, not see what they see.

summary.takeaway: 论文质疑用文本 persona 让视觉语言模型模拟特定人群感知的有效性：persona 并未让模型像描述对象那样“看”，模型只是复述它已知的人群特征，而非真实感知差异。
summary.methods: 将 persona 提示下的 VLM 回答与真实低视力、色盲或听力损失人群的测量结果以及仅使用 persona 陈述事实的简单规则进行比较，并在 14 个模型上测试描述模糊与直接模糊图像的效果，还分析开放模型内部图像信息与答案概率。
summary.relevance: 直接涉及多模态学习与跨模态理解：考察文本模态的 persona 能否对齐视觉模态的感知，提示多模态模型的模态间信息整合存在局限。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明具体模型清单、人群样本规模及任务细节；结论基于所测三类感知条件，能否推广到其他残障或认知差异尚不明确。

papers.title: Episodic looking - using reinforcement learning to bias perception enhances few-shot and continual learning with protection from forgetting
papers.abstract: There is a fundamental contradiction between the desire for models that can generalize, and models that can continuously adapt to recent input with changing statistics. These conditions, captured in few-shot and continual learning settings, can bias or disrupt learned representations. This harms generalization to a broader context, leaving the model unable to overcome input variance. This paper proposes a solution based on the Complementary Learning System architecture (CLS), in which a Short-Term Memory (STM) delegates generalization to a slow, statistical Long-Term Memory (LTM). Delegation is achieved by working in a space of robust, generalized perceptions produced by the LTM. With this separation, the STM can focus on memorizing recent input and avoiding interference between memories. We show that on an image classification task, the resulting CLS model is more resistant to forgetting in a domain-incremental continual learning setting than a baseline ResNet LTM, and generalizes more effectively in a few-shot setting than other continual learners. In the continual setting, overall accuracy is slightly worse than existing continual learning models, but with a different mix of performance characteristics. Results analysis suggests that the model is limited by the representations and representational plasticity of the LTM. In future work, we will seek to address this by replaying STM memories to the LTM.

summary.takeaway: 提出基于互补学习系统（CLS）的架构，让短期记忆在长期记忆产生的稳健广义感知空间中工作，以缓解少样本与持续学习中的干扰和遗忘。
summary.methods: 采用图像分类任务，将快速短期记忆与缓慢统计长期记忆分离，短期记忆负责记忆近期输入，长期记忆负责泛化；与基线 ResNet 长期记忆及其他持续学习模型比较遗忘抵抗与少样本泛化。
summary.relevance: 契合强化学习与持续学习主题，尤其关注表征漂移、灾难性遗忘和少样本适应之间的张力。
summary.caveat: 在持续学习设置中总体准确率略低于现有模型，仅呈现性能特征组合不同；作者指出受长期记忆表征与可塑性限制，回放长期记忆仅为未来工作。

papers.title: OneScene-Bench: Do Vision-Language Models Integrate Evidence Across Views?
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly process multiple views of the same scene, but it remains unclear whether they integrate these observations into a coherent scene-level representation. Existing multi-image evaluations do not isolate this capability, as tasks may admit correct solutions through independent per-view processing without requiring cross-view correspondence. We introduce OneScene-Bench, a controlled benchmark designed to explicitly distinguish when cross-view integration is necessary. Our benchmark evaluates three complementary capabilities on real-world multi-view scenes: unique object counting, cross-view consistency, and spatial reasoning. For counting, we control object overlap across views to separate cases solvable by simple per-view aggregation from those requiring instance-level correspondence. For consistency, we introduce localized edits in shared and view-specific regions, testing whether models distinguish genuine scene contradictions from differences caused by viewpoint and visibility. For spatial reasoning, we construct object relations that require combining spatial evidence across viewpoints to compare physical proximity. We evaluate twelve state-of-the-art open-weight and proprietary VLMs and find that counting accuracy drops substantially on complementary views, ranging from 4.5-50.0%, compared with 45.5-81.5% on complete-overlap examples. Moreover, cross-view consistency remains around 50% across models, including recent proprietary VLMs, despite substantially stronger performance on spatial reasoning. Our results reveal a substantial gap between processing multiple images and integrating evidence across them, highlighting the need for evaluations that explicitly test scene-level multi-view understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/swathisuhas/OneScene-Bench.

summary.takeaway: 提出 OneScene-Bench 受控基准，发现当前 VLM 在需要跨视角整合证据时表现显著下降：多图处理不等于场景级整合。
summary.methods: 基于真实世界多视角场景设计唯一物体计数、跨视角一致性与空间推理三类任务；计数中控制视角间物体重叠以区分逐视角聚合与实例级对应，一致性中用局部编辑区分真实矛盾与视角差异；评测 12 个开放权重与专有 VLM。
summary.relevance: 直接对应多模态学习与跨模态理解，聚焦多视图场景级表征与跨视角证据整合能力。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出基准上的经验结果，未说明场景来源规模与编辑构造的全部细节；跨视角一致性约 50% 等结论限于所测模型与任务。

papers.title: What Does an Ontology Catch? Curated, LLM-Generated and Data-Derived Ontologies as Checkers of LLM Agents over Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: LLM agents that answer questions over Web knowledge graphs are increasingly wrapped in checks derived from the graph's ontology, on the assumption that a formal schema makes a reliable judge. Yet a checker can be wrong as well: it can miss errors, and it can flag correct answers and push the agent into "fixing" them. Whether a curated ontology is worth its cost as such a judge, and how it compares with an ontology an LLM writes or a schema mined from the data, is unknown. We make the checker itself the object of study. Across curated, LLM-generated and data-derived ontologies, used as prompt context, as a checker, or both, and across open-weight and proprietary agents on public graphs and a private graph of nearly $10^{9}$ triples, we account for what ontology-derived checks catch and what they wrongly flag. We show how each source trades caught errors against false alarms, how a curated schema used as published can contradict its own data, which errors structural checks miss, and whether combining sources or giving the agent the checker's specific feedback pays off. On UniProt, the curated ontology flags more correct answers than either an ontology derived from the data or one an LLM derives from a summary of the data with masked identifiers. On real agent answers, its flags are only marginally more precise than random flags.

summary.takeaway: 论文把“本体检查器”本身作为研究对象，比较人工策划、LLM 生成与数据推导三类本体作为 LLM 智能体知识图谱问答检查器的收益与误报。
summary.methods: 在公开图谱与近 10^9 三元组的私有图谱上，将本体分别用作提示上下文、检查器或两者兼用，覆盖开放权重与专有智能体，统计捕获错误与误报正确回答的情况，并比较组合来源与向智能体提供具体反馈的效果。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型与知识图谱主题，讨论形式化 schema 作为智能体监督信号是否可靠。
summary.caveat: 结果显示检查器会漏检并误标正确答案，甚至在 UniProt 上人工本体标记的正确回答多于数据推导本体，真实智能体回答上其标记仅略优于随机；摘要未给出跨图谱的完整量化细节。

papers.title: Cooperative EV Charging Assignment Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning: A Comparison of QMIX and Independent Q-Learning Under Urban Traffic Uncertainty
papers.abstract: The allocation of electric vehicles to public charging stations is increasingly constrained by the fact that several heterogeneous facilities often serve the same stream of requests while observing only partial local information. An accept/reject decision that is defensible for one station may nevertheless reduce the efficiency of the charging district as a whole. We formulate this operational problem as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP) and examine whether Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE), instantiated through QMIX, improves assignment performance relative to a cooperative Independent Q-Learning baseline (IQL). The evaluation uses a six-station urban network simulated with SUMO, five independent random seeds, 200 training episodes, and four traffic flux scenarios ranging from 100 to 250 vehicles/hour. Under this protocol, QMIX reaches a mean reward per evaluated decision of +0.776, versus +0.578 for IQL (delta = +0.198, seed-paired Cohens dz = 2.98, exact two-sided Wilcoxon p = 0.0625, the minimum attainable value at this sample size), and raises the acceptance rate from 72.4% to 94.0% (delta = +21.6 pp, dz = 5.24, Wilcoxon p = 0.0625). A five-variant ablation suggests this gain is primarily attributable to the CTDE architecture when holding cooperative reward terms fixed, though not formally isolated with a single seed. By contrast, cooperative reward shaping and experience sharing show no clear descriptive benefit and may slightly reduce performance. These findings support the view that, for multi-station charging assignment, coordination should be embedded in the learning architecture rather than added only through heuristic cooperation terms.

summary.takeaway: 在多站点电动汽车充电分配这一 Dec-POMDP 中比较 QMIX 与独立 Q-Learning，发现 CTDE 架构的 QMIX 在仿真中取得更高奖励与接受率。
summary.methods: 用 SUMO 模拟六站点城市网络，5 个随机种子、200 个训练回合、4 种交通流量场景（100–250 辆/小时）；比较 QMIX 与协作 IQL，并做五变体消融考察协作奖励塑形与经验共享。
summary.relevance: 契合强化学习与多智能体奖励学习：研究部分可观测下集中训练分散执行与协作机制的作用。
summary.caveat: 样本量仅 5 个种子，Wilcoxon 双侧 p=0.0625 为最小可达值，统计功效有限；消融未用单种子正式隔离 CTDE 贡献，结论需更多重复验证。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Co-Adaptive Hip Exoskeleton Control (MARL-Exo) for Metabolic Energy Reduction
papers.abstract: Objective: This study aims to determine whether a hip-exoskeleton policy trained in simulation, by co-adapting with a musculoskeletal human model under a metabolic-energy reward, reduces the metabolic cost of walking in new users without per-user tuning, and how mechanical-power shaping affects the learned assistance. Methods: We developed MARL-Exo, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework in which a full-body human model (304 muscle actuators; randomized anatomy, gait, and speed) and a bilateral hip-exoskeleton policy are trained concurrently in two stages. The exoskeleton observes only delayed hip kinematics and its past commands; its reward includes muscle metabolic power from a physiologically based energetics model, alone (Metabolic) or with mechanical-power shaping (Metabolic + Power). The Metabolic policy was deployed and tested without retraining in eight healthy adults walking at 1.25 m/s, using indirect calorimetry. Results: In simulation, the Metabolic policy reduced modeled muscle metabolic power by 13.8% relative to no-device walking, versus 8.8% for Metabolic + Power. On hardware, MARL-Exo reduced net metabolic rate by 18.3 $\pm$ 6.6% relative to Passive in all eight participants. Relative to No-Exo, the mean reduction was 7.4 $\pm$ 10.0%; six participants more than offset the 13.1% device-wearing penalty, walking up to 24.2% below their No-Exo cost. Conclusion: A metabolically informed policy co-adapted in simulation transferred to users without per-user tuning and consistently reduced the metabolic cost of walking with the device, while explicit power shaping reduced the simulated benefit. Significance: Unlike per-user human-in-the-loop optimization, this approach yields a single population-level controller and allows assistance objectives to be screened in simulation before human testing.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MARL-Exo，在仿真中让髋部外骨骼策略与肌肉骨骼人体模型在代谢能量奖励下共同适应，得到无需逐用户调参的群体级控制器，并在实验中降低行走代谢成本。
summary.methods: 使用含 304 个肌肉驱动器的全身人体模型，随机化解剖、步态与速度，两阶段多智能体强化学习训练双侧髋外骨骼策略；奖励为生理能量模型估计的肌肉代谢功率，分仅代谢与代谢加机械功率塑形两版；在 8 名健康成人以 1.25 m/s 行走并用间接测热法测试。
summary.relevance: 契合强化学习与多智能体奖励学习，展示多智能体协同训练与奖励设计对实际控制任务的迁移。
summary.caveat: 测试仅 8 名健康成人、单一速度；相对无外骨骼的平均降低为 7.4±10.0%，个体差异大且部分人未获益；机械功率塑形降低了仿真收益，长期真实场景效果未知。

papers.title: CAMR: Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay for Continual Learning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Continual learning requires large language models to acquire new knowledge and capabilities while retaining what they have learned. Fine-tuning and replay support acquisition and retention, but deciding whether incoming examples need supervision and which historical examples to revisit remains a challenge. We propose Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay (CAMR), an adaptive framework that jointly controls current-example supervision and historical replay. CAMR combines compatibility checks with a learned memory gate to guide an online policy over three actions: learning incoming examples with general replay, jointly reinforcing compatible related examples, and skipping direct supervision of verified mastered duplicates. The policy learns from acquisition, retention, and training-cost feedback under a bounded per-arrival replay budget. We evaluate CAMR with Qwen3-8B-Base on continual factual updating and cross-task and cross-domain learning. On WikiBigEdit, CAMR consistently leads evaluated methods in Original Match from 3K to 100K facts, reaching 93.66% after just 3K facts and surpassing Full-history Replay (LoRA) after 100K facts. It also achieves the highest final scores on all four selected TRACE tasks and maintains or improves earlier-task performance relative to post-acquisition levels in a sequence spanning financial question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and summarization.

summary.takeaway: 提出兼容性感知记忆回放 CAMR，联合控制当前样本监督与历史回放，在持续学习中平衡新知识获取与旧知识保持。
summary.methods: 结合兼容性检查与学习型记忆门，在线策略在三种动作间选择：用一般回放学习新样本、联合强化兼容的相关样本、跳过已验证掌握重复样本的直接监督；策略从获取、保持与训练成本反馈中学习，有每次到达的回放预算；用 Qwen3-8B-Base 在 WikiBigEdit 及 TRACE 等任务上评估。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型与持续学习，回应微调与回放中“何时监督、回放什么”的关键问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要主要报告 WikiBigEdit 与四个 TRACE 任务结果，未说明其他基准与模型规模上的表现；回放预算与门控策略的超参数敏感性未展开。

papers.title: Don't Lose the Thread: Empowering Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation
papers.abstract: Agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in solving complex reasoning tasks. However, LLM agents often falter on long-horizon tasks due to cognitive overload, as their working memory becomes cluttered with expanding and irrelevant information, which dilutes their attention and hinders effective planning and reasoning. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation (CORAL), a novel reasoning paradigm that empowers agents to proactively optimize their context. Implemented as an agent-callable working memory management toolset, CORAL allows an agent to checkpoint its task progress and verified facts, and adaptively initiate a new problem-solving episode by resetting cluttered context while preserving only the checkpointed information, enabling it to resume reasoning from a clean state. We further enhance the agent's checkpointing capabilities using a Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization algorithm. On the GAIA benchmark, CORAL with an 8B model achieves 42.8% average accuracy, with particularly strong gains on the most challenging long-horizon tasks (Level 2 and Level 3). Crucially, these gains come at a substantially lower inference cost: CORAL consumes 6-7$\times$ fewer input tokens than a ReAct agent. It also generalizes to multi-hop Knowledge QA benchmarks and to the considerably harder BrowseComp, where it improves a strong proprietary agent by 8.0 points.

summary.takeaway: 提出认知资源自分配 CORAL，让 LLM 智能体通过可调用的工作记忆管理工具检查点化任务进展并重置杂乱上下文，以缓解长程任务中的认知过载。
summary.methods: 将工作记忆管理实现为智能体可调用的工具集，支持记录已验证事实与进度后开启新问题求解回合；用多回合智能体强化策略优化算法增强检查点能力；在 GAIA、多跳知识问答与 BrowseComp 上评估。
summary.relevance: 契合大语言模型、检索增强与对齐以及强化学习主题，关注长程智能体的上下文管理与策略优化。
summary.caveat: 摘要以 8B 模型在 GAIA 上达 42.8% 平均准确率并减少输入 token，但未给出各分项方差、工具调用失败率及更长任务上的稳定性；BrowseComp 上仅报告相对某专有智能体提升 8.0 分。

papers.title: SpectralTF-MAE: A Pre-trained Spectral Foundation Model for Tokamak Fusion Plasma Diagnostics
papers.abstract: Spectroscopic diagnostics provide rich information for characterizing plasma states in tokamak fusion experiments, while existing learning-based approaches are often designed for individual tasks and rely heavily on labeled data. In this work, we propose SpectralTF-MAE, a self-supervised spectral foundation model for tokamak plasma diagnostics. The model is pretrained on paired charge-exchange recombination spectroscopy (CXRS) and X-ray crystal spectroscopy (XCS) measurements through masked spectral reconstruction. To better capture diagnostically important spectral structures, we introduce a peak-aware masking strategy together with a peak-enhanced reconstruction objective, encouraging the model to focus on characteristic spectral regions. A shared Transformer encoder is employed to learn transferable representations across different diagnostic modalities. The pretrained model is further adapted to several downstream tasks, including plasma-parameter prediction, cross-diagnostic spectral generation, and spectral peak analysis. Experiments on EAST diagnostic data demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance across different tasks and consistently benefits from self-supervised spectral pretraining. These results indicate the potential of SpectralTF-MAE as a general and transferable representation learning framework for plasma spectroscopic diagnostics.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SpectralTF-MAE，一个面向托卡马克等离子体诊断的自监督光谱基础模型，通过掩码光谱重建在 CXRS 与 XCS 配对数据上预训练，并迁移到多个下游任务。
summary.methods: 在电荷交换复合光谱（CXRS）与 X 射线晶体光谱（XCS）配对测量上做掩码光谱重建预训练；引入峰值感知掩码与峰值增强重建目标；使用共享 Transformer 编码器学习跨诊断模态的可迁移表示；在 EAST 诊断数据上适配参数预测、跨诊断光谱生成和谱峰分析等任务。
summary.relevance: 直接对应预训练与自监督表示学习主题，展示跨诊断模态的共享编码器与掩码重建预训练在科学光谱数据上的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在 EAST 数据上取得有竞争力的性能，未给出具体指标数值、与基线的定量差距或跨装置泛化证据。

papers.title: Systematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding for Representation Learning in Neurodegenerative Diseases
papers.abstract: Early identification of neurodegenerative disorders using structural T1-weighted MRI is essential for timely clinical intervention, yet supervised deep learning models often struggle to generalize due to limited annotations and scanner-induced distribution shift. Self-supervised learning offers a promising alternative; however, existing approaches are largely adapted from natural image paradigms, relying on contrastive objectives or generic masked reconstruction with voxel-wise losses, which may not fully capture the distributed morphometric patterns associated with neurodegeneration. We introduce SYMBA (SYstematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding), a self-supervised pretraining framework specifically designed for structural brain MRI. SYMBA integrates anatomically constrained masking, a multi-scale structural similarity (MS-SSIM) reconstruction objective, and a progressive curriculum that transitions from local anatomical detail to global brain morphology. These components explicitly incorporate neuroanatomical structure into the self-supervised objective rather than relying on generic image priors. Pretrained on 6,953 T1-weighted MRI scans from nine heterogeneous cohorts, SYMBA is evaluated using frozen linear probing on two independent unseen datasets, enabling a strict assessment of out-of-distribution generalization. Across multiple clinical tasks, SYMBA consistently outperforms recent neuroimaging foundation models, achieving 0.930 AUROC for Alzheimer's disease classification, 0.772 for mild cognitive impairment conversion prediction, and strong performance in amyloid status prediction. In low-label regimes, SYMBA demonstrates high sample efficiency, reaching approximately 0.90 AUROC for AD/CN classification using only six labeled subjects.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SYMBA，一个针对结构性脑 MRI 设计的自监督预训练框架，将解剖约束融入掩码与重建目标，并在分布外数据上取得优于近期神经影像基础模型的表现。
summary.methods: 整合解剖约束掩码、多尺度结构相似性（MS-SSIM）重建目标和从局部解剖细节到全局脑形态的渐进式课程；在来自九个异质队列的 6,953 例 T1 加权 MRI 上预训练；用冻结线性探针在两个独立未见数据集上评估。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与自监督表示学习主题，体现将领域结构先验显式嵌入自监督目标而非依赖通用图像先验的思路。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的 AUROC 与低标签样本效率均来自冻结线性探针评估，未说明微调设定下的表现；预训练队列的异质性可能影响可复现性细节。

papers.title: Multibranch Ensemble Head in Vision Foundation Models for Efficient Cucumber Phenological Stage Classification
papers.abstract: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) pretrained with self-supervised learning, such as DINOv2, provide highly transferable features, yet adapting them to small, domain-shifted datasets is still challenging. We propose a regularizing multibranch ensemble head: a training and inference scheme that pairs low- and high-capacity branches, samples a single branch stochastically at each training step, and averages both branches in probability space at inference. The design adds negligible parameters and essentially no inference overhead over a single heavy head, while improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off under data-scarce conditions. Accurate classification of plant growth stages is critical for precision agriculture, enabling timely decisions on fertilization, irrigation, and harvesting. Therefore, as a challenging practical case we use cucumber phenological stage classification, in which flowers and fruits are frequently occluded by foliage, and stage transitions manifest primarily as subtle changes in leaf morphology. The NALEF Food Safety dataset contains images of five cucumber growth stages captured under diverse real-world conditions. On it we evaluate a broad range of backbones, including DINOv2 and DINOv3 ViT and ConvNeXt variants, against strongly supervised counterparts (ResNet, EfficientNet, ViT). The proposed DINOv2 ViT-S with multibranch head achieves a Macro F1 of 0.978 and Cohen's Kappa of 0.971, matching the performance of models more than ten times larger in parameters and GFlops, while requiring only 12.2 GFlops and 22.3M parameters, making it deployable on smartphones and edge devices for phenological stage classification.

summary.takeaway: 提出一种多分支集成头训练与推理方案，在数据稀缺条件下改善视觉基础模型（如 DINOv2）的精度—效率权衡，并在黄瓜物候期分类上以较小模型匹配大十余倍模型的性能。
summary.methods: 训练时随机采样低容量或高容量分支，推理时在概率空间平均两分支；在 NALEF Food Safety 数据集的五个黄瓜生长阶段图像上，比较 DINOv2、DINOv3 的 ViT 与 ConvNeXt 变体及 ResNet、EfficientNet、ViT 等监督基线。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与自监督表示学习主题，关注自监督视觉基础模型在小规模、域偏移数据上的适配策略。
summary.caveat: 评估集中于单一农业数据集与单一分类任务，摘要未提供跨数据集或跨作物验证；与强监督基线的比较细节有限。

papers.title: scTGCL: A Transformer-Based Graph Contrastive Learning Approach for Efficiently Clustering Single-Cell RNA-seq Data
papers.abstract: Motivation: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables characterization of cellular heterogeneity at unprecedented resolution. However, accurate clustering of scRNA-seq data remains challenging due to high dimensionality, dropout-induced sparsity, and technical noise. Existing contrastive learning methods usually create augmented views by perturbing gene expression values, so the uncertainty in cell-cell relationships caused by dropout events is not properly modeled. Results: We propose scTGCL, a novel Transformer-based graph contrastive learning framework that learns robust and discriminative cell representations directly from gene expression data. scTGCL employs multi-head self-attention to adaptively construct weighted cell-cell graphs and a Transformer encoder to generate cell embeddings from them, capturing diverse biological relationships. For contrastive augmentation, we apply feature-level gene masking together with attention masking that randomly drops edges of the learned attention matrices, enabling the model to withstand dropout events and technical noise. A symmetric contrastive loss maximizes agreement between original and augmented representations, while joint optimization with reconstruction and imputation losses preserves biological interpretability. Extensive experiments on twenty real and simulated scRNA-seq datasets demonstrate that scTGCL achieves the highest average performance among nine state-of-the-art baseline methods in clustering accuracy, normalized mutual information, and adjusted Rand index, while also achieving superior imputation performance and substantially lower runtime on large-scale datasets. Furthermore, biological analysis confirms that the learned clusters align with known cell types and yield biologically interpretable pathway enrichment, validating the utility of scTGCL for downstream cell annotation and marker gene discovery. Availability and Implementation: The source code and test data are freely available at GitHub (https://github.com/ShoaibAbdullahKhan/scTGCL)

summary.takeaway: 提出 scTGCL，一个基于 Transformer 的图对比学习框架，直接从基因表达数据学习稳健且有判别性的细胞表示，用于 scRNA-seq 聚类。
summary.methods: 用多头自注意力自适应构建加权细胞—细胞图，再由 Transformer 编码器生成细胞嵌入；对比增强采用特征级基因掩码与注意力掩码（随机丢弃注意力矩阵的边）；对称对比损失联合重建与插补损失优化；在二十个真实与模拟 scRNA-seq 数据集上与九个最先进基线比较。
summary.relevance: 对应自监督与表示学习主题，将图对比学习与 Transformer 结合用于高维稀疏单细胞数据，并保留生物学可解释性。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的“最高平均性能”为跨数据集的平均结果，未给出各数据集上的具体数值或方差；生物学验证以已知细胞类型和通路富集描述，缺少独立验证队列的细节。

papers.title: Surprise Alone Learns Lies: Evidence-Gated Continual Learning for LLMs from Streaming Claims
papers.abstract: Continual learning methods for large language models increasingly decide what to learn by surprise, keeping the inputs the model finds least predictable. This rule is unsafe when the stream contains lies. A planted falsehood about something the model knows has low probability under the model's belief, so it is highly surprising by construction, and a surprise-driven learner absorbs nearly every such lie, at a rate similar to random selection with the same budget. We study the problem with LoRA-adapted students (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B) that learn from a stream of true and false claims about invented people and real CounterFact facts. We report four findings. (1) A verifier key, a judge that must approve each claim, removes lies to the extent that its verifier is accurate; real LLM judges are cautious and reject unsourced truths and even source-backed updates. (2) Calibrated regression tests on unrelated knowledge slow learning down without filtering out lies. (3) The original model's own prior flags claims that contradict what it knows, without a judge. It separates lies about known facts from true new facts (AUC 0.78-0.83 across three models) but not from legitimate updates of the same kind of fact (AUC 0.53). It saves 43% of judge calls, but an attacker with access to the model can choose lies that pass it. (4) If trusted sources exist that an attacker cannot plant, routing contradicted claims to evidence recovers legitimate updates and the combined system has the lowest poison rate among learned claims; when an attacker plants matching sources for 30% of the lies, the system ends up worse than the judge alone. The acceptance signals answer different questions, and none of them decides on its own whether a claim is true.

summary.takeaway: 指出以“惊奇度”驱动的大语言模型持续学习在含虚假陈述的数据流中不安全，并系统比较验证器、回归测试、模型自身先验和证据路由等接受信号的过滤效果与局限。
summary.methods: 使用 LoRA 适配的 Qwen2.5-1.5B、Qwen2.5-3B 和 Llama-3.2-3B，在关于虚构人物与真实 CounterFact 事实的真假陈述流上学习；评估验证器密钥、校准回归测试、模型先验标记和证据路由四种机制，并考察攻击者种植匹配来源的情形。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与持续学习主题，直接讨论从流式声明中学习时如何判断该学什么。
summary.caveat: 实验限于三个小型开源模型、虚构人物与 CounterFact 构造数据，摘要未说明真实场景中的迁移效果；部分结论（如 43% 减少判定调用、AUC 区间）依赖特定攻击设定。

papers.title: GistRank: Gist-Compressed Listwise Ranking with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become a powerful tool for listwise relevance ranking, which can improve web search by comparing retrieved passages jointly. However, processing every candidate verbatim and generating a permutation autoregressively can make inference costly, every candidate must be serialized verbatim into the prompt and the input therefore grows linearly with both the number and the length of the passages. While sliding-window ranking handles context limits through repeated re-encoding of overlapping blocks, hard compression techniques sacrifice the fine-grained details required for accurate discriminative judgment. To better understand and mitigate this trade-off, we conduct a comprehensive study of soft compression for LLM-based listwise ranking. Our findings reveal that a vanilla gist representation is ill-suited to ranking for two reasons: strictly causal encoding weakens how thoroughly each gist token absorbs its passage, and the representation is never trained to expose the relative-preference structure that separates closely competing candidates. To this end, we propose GistRank, a three-stage training framework that equips a large language model with gist-compressed passage representations by learning faithful gist tokens under a semi-bidirectional attention scheme, instilling discriminative comparison through pairwise training, and adapting the model to the listwise objective. GistRank collapses each passage into only $K{=}4$ gist tokens, this gives 14$\times$ speedups over one-shot full-text ranking while reaching 59.17 average nDCG@10 over TREC DL19/20 and five BEIR subsets within 0.89 of the strongest full-context baseline. Overall, GistRank provides an effective means to enhance efficiency for searches in real-world environments.

summary.takeaway: 提出 GistRank，一种三阶段训练框架，使大语言模型以 gist 压缩表示进行列表排序，在显著降低推理成本的同时接近全文上下文基线。
summary.methods: 学习半双向注意力下的忠实 gist token，将每段文本压缩为 K=4 个 gist token；通过成对训练注入判别性比较能力；再适配列表级排序目标；在 TREC DL19/20 与五个 BEIR 子集上评估 nDCG@10。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与检索增强/对齐主题，研究 LLM 列表排序中的软压缩效率—精度权衡。
summary.caveat: 摘要给出的 59.17 平均 nDCG@10 与 0.89 相对差距为跨数据集汇总，未列出各数据集结果；加速比相对一次性全文排序设定，实际部署收益可能依赖具体候选数量。

papers.title: Category-Anchored Large Language Models for Next POI Recommendation
papers.abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation aims to predict a user's next destination from spatio-temporal check-in data, and serves as the foundation for many location-based services. Recent advances incorporate large language models (LLMs) into this task by textualizing user trajectories to exploit their semantic reasoning ability. However, directly generating POI identifiers with such models is unreliable: POIs are sparse, localized, and long-tailed entities with weak natural-language semantics, which creates a semantic-to-entity gap between high-level mobility intent and concrete POI prediction. To bridge this gap, we propose ANCHOR, a category-anchored framework for semantic-to-entity grounding in next POI recommendation. Specifically, ANCHOR first estimates category-level mobility intent in a compact and stable semantic space, rather than predicting concrete POI entities directly. The inferred intent is then grounded into a candidate set by integrating three complementary sources of mobility evidence: category anchors, historical visit memory, and user preferences. Finally, a history-aware reranker selects the target POI by matching each candidate with the user's historical mobility patterns and current context. Experiments on three real-world check-in datasets show that ANCHOR consistently outperforms representative traditional, structure-enhanced, and LLM-based baselines on the reported metrics. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of semantic-to-entity grounding and show favorable trade-offs among candidate coverage, ranking quality, and inference efficiency.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ANCHOR，一个类别锚定的框架，先估计类别级移动意图再落地到具体 POI，以缓解 LLM 直接生成 POI 标识符的语义—实体鸿沟。
summary.methods: 在紧凑稳定的语义空间估计类别级移动意图；结合类别锚、历史访问记忆和用户偏好三类证据构建候选集；用历史感知重排序器结合历史移动模式与当前上下文选取目标 POI；在三个真实签到数据集上与传统、结构增强和 LLM 基线比较。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与检索增强/对齐主题，体现用候选检索加重排序替代 LLM 直接生成实体的思路。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在报告指标上持续优于基线，未给出具体数值；分析限于三个签到数据集，候选覆盖与排序质量之间的权衡仅以定性方式描述。

papers.title: What Makes Medical Examination Items Difficult? Using Large Language Models to Explore Patterns Associated With Empirical Item Difficulty
papers.abstract: Research on medical item difficulty has largely focused on prediction rather than on identifying interpretable patterns associated with empirical difficulty. This study used empirical difficulty labels to guide large language models (LLMs) in inducing difficulty rubrics and examined how rubric guidance affected LLM difficulty judgments. Using training items and their empirical difficulty estimates from the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) and the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination (PANCE), Claude Opus 5 induced separate rubrics for absolute and pairwise difficulty judgment. None of the induced rubrics treated surface features, such as stem length, option count, or images, as major sources of difficulty. Several patterns emerged across both examinations, including cue convergence, misleading cues, and option competition, although their specific forms differed. Retrieval of knowledge that could not be derived from the stem was particularly prominent in the PANCE rubrics, whereas the USMLE rubrics placed greater emphasis on integrating multiple clinical cues. We compared commercial and open-weight LLMs on held-out items under unguided and rubric-guided conditions. Rubric guidance changed how models used the difficulty scale but did not consistently improve performance. In absolute judgments, guidance encouraged broader use of the scale and generally improved coarse-grained agreement, without consistently improving rank ordering. In pairwise comparisons, its effects varied across models and examinations, and judgments became more sensitive to presentation order. These findings suggest that the value of label-guided rubric induction may lie more in generating interpretable, testable hypotheses from empirical difficulty data than in reliably improving difficulty judgments.

summary.takeaway: 利用经验难度标签引导大语言模型归纳可解释的题目难度评分规则，发现规则引导改变模型对难度量表的使用方式，但未一致提升难度判断性能。
summary.methods: 使用 USMLE 与 PANCE 的训练题目及其经验难度估计，由 Claude Opus 5 分别归纳绝对难度与成对比较难度规则；在留出题目上比较商业与开放权重模型在无引导与规则引导条件下的表现。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与检索增强/对齐主题，考察 LLM 在教育测量任务中的可解释模式归纳与判断校准。
summary.caveat: 摘要明确指出规则引导未一致改善性能，成对判断还更受呈现顺序影响；结论基于两项医学考试数据，归纳出的评分规则与具体考试形式绑定。

papers.title: From Local Recovery to Unified Generation: Discovering Triple Set in Knowledge Graphs via Observation-Anchored Latent Diffusion
papers.abstract: Triple set prediction (TSP) is to recover missing relational triples in a knowledge graph by predicting the triple set instead of isolated links. Existing approaches predominantly rely on the subgraph-based completion paradigm, where the original graph is first partitioned into local subgraphs which are then independently completed. Such a paradigm suffers from fragmented structural reasoning, limited cross subgraph dependency modeling, and missing predictions across subgraphs. This paper proposes LatentDiff, a novel unified latent generative framework for TSP, which reformulates knowledge graph completion as latent space graph generation. LatentDiff first learns a compact latent representation using a relation-aware residual-quantized knowledge graph autoencoder, which encodes the whole graph into relation-aware latent embeddings, quantizes them with chunked residual codebooks, and reconstructs triples through a factorized decoder. On top of this latent space, we introduce an observation-anchored latent graph diffusion model, where the target latent graph representation is perturbed toward the observed latent. The reverse process recovers missing triples through progressive latent denoising. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that LatentDiff outperforms the SOTA in terms of F_{tsp} by 5.4 percentage points on average. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LKGDiff-44A5.

summary.takeaway: 提出 LatentDiff，将知识图谱三元组集合预测重构为统一潜空间图生成，避免子图分区带来的结构推理碎片化。
summary.methods: 用关系感知残差量化知识图谱自编码器将整图编码为紧凑潜嵌入并分块量化，再经因子分解解码器重构三元组；在潜空间上使用以观测潜表示为锚点的扩散模型，通过逐步去噪恢复缺失三元组；在三个基准数据集上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接面向知识图谱补全与三元组集合预测，属于知识图谱表示与推理方向，与检索增强及知识图谱主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明基准数据集名称、基线设置与消融细节；性能提升以平均 F_tsp 报告，缺少按数据集或复杂度的分解。

papers.title: TaxoMFM: A Taxonomy-Aware Foundation Model for the Human Gut Microbiome
papers.abstract: Existing gut microbiome foundation models typically use flat taxon representations, limiting their ability to exploit known taxonomic hierarchies. We introduce TaxoMFM, a microbiome foundation model that integrates taxonomic structure into self-supervised learning. TaxoMFM jointly learns abundance patterns across taxonomic ranks and relative proportions within groups through taxonomy-aware encoding and hierarchical compositional reconstruction. We further construct TaxoGut-HPP, comprising 100,806 gut microbiome profiles from 231 source cohorts and covering 40 classification and 8 regression tasks. TaxoMFM achieves competitive performance across disease, gut health, host trait, and liver ultrasound phenotype prediction. In cross-cohort zero-shot transfer, where target cohorts are excluded from both pretraining and downstream adaptation, TaxoMFM achieves AUROCs of 0.838, 0.736, and 0.722 for colorectal cancer, type 2 diabetes, and inflammatory bowel disease, respectively. Further analyses show that TaxoMFM recovers community changes across taxonomic scales, while preserving community information and producing consistent representations under database updates and species-vocabulary shifts. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TaxoMFM-F16D/.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TaxoMFM，将分类学层级结构融入肠道微生物组自监督基础模型，并构建大规模多任务基准 TaxoGut-HPP。
summary.methods: 通过分类学感知编码与层级组成重构联合学习各分类层级丰度模式及组内相对比例；构建含 100,806 个肠道微生物组样本、231 个来源队列、40 个分类与 8 个回归任务的数据集；报告跨队列零样本迁移 AUROC。
summary.relevance: 属于预训练与自监督表示学习在生物医学数据上的应用，涉及基础模型与层级结构先验。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出部分任务的零样本 AUROC 与定性分析，未说明全部任务的具体数值、基线对比细节及数据来源潜在偏倚。

papers.title: CoSTA: Co-Evolving Self-Play Timeline Agents for Complex Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.abstract: Complex Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) involves more than retrieving facts: the timestamp or validity interval of one fact can constrain the search for another, while multiple intervals may jointly determine the answer. Existing single-agent TKGQA methods typically investigate these facts within a single reasoning context, where evidence from different event histories can become interleaved and distractors can misdirect subsequent retrieval. Distributing investigations across agents can separate event-specific evidence into distinct contexts, but effective collaboration must still be learned because question decomposition, subtask investigation, and evidence synthesis are interdependent. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{Co}-Evolving \textbf{S}elf-Play \textbf{T}imeline \textbf{A}gents (CoSTA), which organizes facts into navigable timelines, delegates investigations to workers, and uses a coordinator to synthesize their original timestamped observations. CoSTA initializes a shared policy through role-conditioned distillation and jointly optimizes both roles through co-evolving self-play with final-answer rewards. Across three benchmarks, CoSTA achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, with particularly strong gains on complex multi-fact questions, while its compact variants outperform the evaluated closed-source LLM agents.

summary.takeaway: 提出 CoSTA，用可导航时间线与多智能体自博弈协作处理复杂时序知识图谱问答，将不同事件证据分离到独立上下文。
summary.methods: 把事实组织为时间线，由 worker 分头调查、coordinator 综合带时间戳的原始观测；通过角色条件蒸馏初始化共享策略，并用最终答案奖励进行协同演化自博弈联合优化；在三个基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 面向大语言模型智能体与时序知识图谱问答，结合知识图谱检索与多智能体协作，与两个匹配主题均相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未列出三个基准的具体名称与数值，也未说明自博弈训练成本及对时间标注质量的依赖。

papers.title: VenusGenome: Genome-Aware Masked Autoencoding for Microbial Genome Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Genomic-context models have shown that contextualizing protein embeddings can improve predictions of microbial function. We observe that a gene's protein embedding is partially predictable from the embeddings of neighboring genes in the genome, motivating high-ratio masking that requires reconstruction from sparser genomic context. Genomic modeling must also distinguish biological relationships from assembly conventions, since the ordering of separate contigs does not imply adjacency and strand labels depend on the reference orientation. We therefore introduce VenusGenome, a gene-resolution masked autoencoder that combines visible-only encoding with genome-aware attention incorporating contig boundaries, relative strand orientations, and gene positions. We pretrain this model on a curated corpus of over 1.7 million microbial genome assemblies from isolate and metagenomic sources, using frozen protein embeddings as gene-level inputs. Across genome-level phenotype prediction and gene-level tasks, the resulting frozen representations achieve the highest mean performance among the evaluated models on nine of eleven primary metrics. An exploratory gene-input perturbation analysis further links representation sensitivity to experimentally measured fitness defects. Ablations support the contribution of genome-aware attention and show the benefits of masked autoencoding over BERT-style masked modeling, with further gains from higher masking ratios.

summary.takeaway: 提出 VenusGenome，一种基因分辨率掩码自编码器，利用基因组上下文与高掩码率学习微生物基因组表示。
summary.methods: 以冻结的蛋白质嵌入作为基因级输入，使用仅可见编码与基因组感知注意力，纳入 contig 边界、相对链方向和基因位置；在超过 170 万个微生物基因组组装上预训练；在基因组级表型预测与基因级任务上评估，并进行消融与扰动分析。
summary.relevance: 属于自监督预训练与生物序列表示学习，强调基因组结构先验与高比例掩码。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在 11 项主要指标中 9 项取得最高平均表现，但未列出指标名称、具体数值与对比模型；扰动分析与适应度缺陷的关联仅为探索性。

papers.title: Generative Replay for Equilibrium Propagation: Toward Edge-Friendly Continual Learning in Hopfield Networks
papers.abstract: Equilibrium Propagation (EqProp) offers a biologically grounded and hardware-aligned alternative to backpropagation for training Hopfield Networks. However, its behavior in continual learning settings remains largely unexplored. This work confronts catastrophic forgetting in EqProp-trained Hopfield Networks from the inside out, eliminating the need for external data buffers or architectural overhead that standard Experience Replay \textbf{(ER)} and Generative Replay \textbf{(Gen-Replay)} inevitably require. We introduce an Energy-Based Generative Replay strategy \textbf{(EB-Gen)} which exploits the intrinsic generative dynamics of Hopfield Networks, allowing a single model to act as both classifier and replay samples generator. Samples capturing past task knowledge are generated by relaxing a frozen copy of the network, enabling rehearsal solely through internally generated pseudo-data. We evaluate the proposed method in the Class-Incremental setting, using the split versions of the MNIST and CIFAR10 benchmarks and compare it with FineTune, Experience Replay, Generative Replay, Sleep-Like Replay Consolidation (SRC) and Joint training. Our results show that EB-Gen significantly improves stability while preserving plasticity, achieving a 75\% and 64\% average accuracy on Split MNIST and Split CIFAR10 respectively. These findings show that Equilibrium Propagation can be adapted to alleviate catastrophic forgetting without forgoing the traits which made it compelling in the first place.

summary.takeaway: 提出 EB-Gen，利用 Hopfield 网络内在生成动力学实现能量基生成回放，使 EqProp 训练的模型在类增量学习中缓解灾难性遗忘。
summary.methods: 冻结网络副本通过弛豫生成过去任务的伪样本用于 rehearsa，无需外部数据缓冲或额外架构；在 Split MNIST 与 Split CIFAR10 上与 FineTune、Experience Replay、Generative Replay、SRC 及 Joint training 比较。
summary.relevance: 涉及持续学习与灾难性遗忘，采用生成回放策略，与持续学习主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 评估限于两个拆分图像基准，摘要未报告遗忘度量、任务序列设置细节及与其他方法差异的统计显著性。

papers.title: SymAnt: Grounding Long-Horizon Action Anticipation with Adaptable Symbolic Priors
papers.abstract: As robots and intelligent systems increasingly interact with humans, they must anticipate long sequences of future actions from only brief observations. While purely neural models typically require extensive observations to predict future actions and remain difficult to interpret and adjust, symbolic priors offer a structured alternative. To this end, we introduce SymAnt, a novel neuro-symbolic approach that unifies the expressiveness of neural networks with the structured reasoning of scene and knowledge graphs. Given a short video, SymAnt performs a joint-search over both graphs to construct a symbolic context, enabling unified reasoning over spatial relationships, object attributes, affordances, and associated actions. This symbolic context serves as a prior for an iterative refinement process that progressively generates and improves the sequence of future actions. By grounding predictions in symbolic context, SymAnt anticipates long-horizon actions from short observation windows in a parameter-efficient manner, while enabling users to directly edit the underlying knowledge to adjust predictions without further training. Through our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of SymAnt, particularly when only short observation contexts are available, across five diverse datasets: Breakfast, 50 Salads, EPIC-KITCHENS, EGTEA Gaze+, and Assembly101.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SymAnt，用场景图与知识图谱联合搜索构建符号上下文，作为先验引导长时程动作预测，并支持用户直接编辑知识调整预测。
summary.methods: 给定短观察视频，在场景图与知识图谱上联合搜索，整合空间关系、物体属性、可供性与动作，形成符号上下文；以此为先验迭代生成并精化未来动作序列；在 Breakfast、50 Salads、EPIC-KITCHENS、EGTEA Gaze+ 与 Assembly101 五个数据集上实验。
summary.relevance: 属于神经符号方法与知识图谱应用，强调图谱构建与表示在动作预测中的结构化先验作用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出各数据集的具体指标与数值，也未说明符号上下文构建对图谱质量或人工知识的依赖程度。

papers.title: Vision-Based Density Estimation for Adaptive Traffic Control
papers.abstract: Traffic congestion is becoming a critical challenge in rapidly growing urban centers, particularly in developing nations where rapid urbanization and inadequate transport infrastructure place increasing strain on transport networks. In highly heterogeneous and chaotic traffic flows, camera-based traffic-state estimation is limited by severe vehicle occlusion and overlap. In this paper, we propose a framework to optimize traffic flow directly from stochastic visual observations. The architecture is structurally decoupled into three primary components: (a) vehicle density estimation, (b) predictive dynamics modeling, and (c) policy optimization. The proposed methodology introduces a convolutional neural network (CNN) that learns the mapping from camera feeds to spatial density maps, utilizing an adaptive k-nearest-neighbor (k-NN) Gaussian kernel to handle varying congestion levels. This feeds into an ST3DNet predictive module for spatiotemporal forecasting, followed by a hierarchical Graph-Transformer Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) algorithm to optimize signal phases. The density estimation stage was evaluated on 40 annotated intersection images from Rambagh 4, Jaipur, India, with a reported five-fold validation mean absolute error (MAE) of $3.32 \pm 0.95$ vehicles and a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 14.5%. These results pertain to the perception component; empirical training and evaluation of the forecasting and control stages remain future work.

summary.takeaway: 提出面向自适应交通控制的视觉密度估计框架，将车辆密度估计、预测动力学与信号策略优化解耦。
summary.methods: 用 CNN 从摄像头画面学习空间密度图，采用自适应 k-NN 高斯核应对拥堵变化；接入 ST3DNet 做时空预测，再用分层 Graph-Transformer 多智能体强化学习优化信号相位；密度估计在印度斋浦尔 Rambagh 4 的 40 张标注路口图像上做五折验证。
summary.relevance: 涉及强化学习与多智能体交通控制，同时包含图结构表示，与强化学习及多智能体主题相关。
